flows.name: Architecture Decision Record
flows.description: Research existing ADRs + context, design alternatives, draft the ADR, critique it, then fold the critique into a final ADR

flows.name: Analyze stack trace
flows.description: Parse the trace, locate frames in the codebase, diagnose root cause, then propose a fix

flows.name: API contract design
flows.description: Research existing endpoints, design the new contract, draft schemas, adversarially critique them, then fold the critique into a final contract

flows.name: Changelog from commits
flows.description: Pull recent commits, group by conventional type, then emit polished CHANGELOG entries

flows.name: Debug CI failure
flows.description: Gather CI logs + config, diagnose root cause, then propose a concrete fix

flows.name: Close stale issues
flows.description: List issues, filter for staleness, draft close comments, then post on approval

flows.name: Code Review
flows.description: Survey the diff, review for correctness and security with independent reviewers, adversarially verify the findings, then format a final report

flows.name: Search company knowledge
flows.description: Fan out searches across Confluence + Jira, deep-read top hits, then synthesize a cited answer

flows.name: Coverage gap report
flows.description: Diff recent changes, analyze test coverage, then format a gap report ranked by risk

flows.name: Triage customer feedback
flows.description: Read customer feedback (email/transcript/blob), search Jira for duplicates, draft a ticket, then file it on approval

flows.name: Data model design
flows.description: Research existing schema, design new tables/indexes/constraints, draft DDL, critique it for safety, then fold the critique into a final model

flows.name: Dead-code finder
flows.description: Scan for unreferenced symbols, verify each candidate is truly dead, then format a deletion plan

flows.name: Debug Error Logs
flows.description: Diagnose error logs, locate the failing code, draft a fix, verify it with an independent reviewer, then write up the result

flows.name: Dependency upgrade audit
flows.description: Scan installed deps, cross-check vulnerability feeds, analyze breakage risk, then format an upgrade plan

flows.name: Dockerfile review
flows.description: Read the Dockerfile and context, review for size/security/cache issues, then draft concrete fixes

flows.name: Generate Documentation
flows.description: Survey code, design a doc outline, draft each section, then polish for accuracy and prose

flows.name: Estimate Jira ticket
flows.description: Fetch the ticket, scope it against the repo, weigh risks, then deliver story points with rationale

flows.name: Flaky test hunter
flows.description: Gather CI logs, identify flaky tests, diagnose causes, then draft fixes

flows.name: Incident postmortem from notes
flows.description: Gather the incident record, build a timeline and root-cause analysis, draft the postmortem, critique it for blamelessness and completeness, then finalize

flows.name: Jira ticket to PR
flows.description: Fetch the ticket, design a plan, implement with a critic loop, review, apply a single fix pass, then open a PR on approval

flows.name: License audit
flows.description: Inventory dep licenses + repo LICENSE files, analyze for conflicts, then format an audit report

flows.name: Data migration plan
flows.description: Survey current schema + scale, design an online migration with rollback, draft scripts, critique them for safety, then fold the critique into a final plan

flows.name: On-call runbook
flows.description: Read the incident write-up, extract canonical steps, draft a runbook, critique it for completeness, then fold the critique into a final runbook

flows.name: Onboarding doc
flows.description: Survey the repo, outline an onboarding guide, draft each section, then polish

flows.name: Product idea → Jira tickets
flows.description: Turn a freeform product idea or feature brief into a Jira epic with implementation tickets, created on approval

flows.name: Productboard feature → Jira tickets
flows.description: Read a Productboard feature URL or description, break it into an epic + stories, then create them on approval

flows.name: Publish status to Confluence
flows.description: Pull recent Jira activity, summarize progress + blockers, draft a Confluence page with narrative flow, then publish on approval

flows.name: Release notes from PRs
flows.description: Gather merged PRs since last tag, categorize, then write user-facing release notes

flows.name: Security review
flows.description: Map the diff, scan for OWASP-style issues, adversarially verify each finding with a fresh reviewer, then format a report

flows.name: Solve a ticket end-to-end
flows.description: Fetch a Jira ticket, design a plan, implement with a critic loop, review, apply a single fix pass, write tests, then open a PR on approval

flows.name: Spec → Jira tickets
flows.description: Fetch a Confluence spec, break it into an epic + stories, draft tickets, then create them on approval

flows.name: Sprint retrospective
flows.description: Pull sprint tickets, analyze wins/blockers/themes, then draft a retro doc

flows.name: Support ticket → Jira bug
flows.description: Convert a support ticket (Zendesk/email blob) into a well-structured Jira bug after checking for duplicates, then file it on approval

flows.name: System design doc
flows.description: Research the area, design alternatives, draft a full design doc, adversarially critique it, then fold the critique into a final doc

flows.name: Terraform plan review
flows.description: Parse the plan, assess blast radius and rollback, then format a risk-ranked report

flows.name: Triage GitHub issue
flows.description: Fetch the issue, explore the repo, diagnose, then propose a resolution + labels

flows.name: Weekly status report
flows.description: Pull 7d of Jira activity, summarize themes, then format a status report
